related.title: Kubernetes RBAC：加法權限與服務帳號契約
related.titleEn: Kubernetes RBAC: additive permissions and service-account contracts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付12項政策表、三個修正方案、準入正負樣本與例外到期測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver twelve policy rows, three remediation plans, admission fixtures and exception-expiry tests.
related.difference: 把主體、namespace、資源與動詞展開成集合，找出多個綁定合併後多出的權限。
related.differenceEn: Expand subject, namespace, resource and verb tuples into sets and identify excess permissions after combining bindings.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合規比例=通過所選政策的工作負載/適用工作負載；額外唯讀要求不能誤稱為全部標準的必需條件。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 12個工作負載中9個通過指定Restricted版本與本地附加政策，3個有明確缺口。 初始通過率9/12=75%。
有效權限是所有適用允許集合的聯集；移除一個綁定不代表該權限必定消失。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 Role A允許6個不同動作，Role B允許5個，兩者重疊2個；控制器實際只需4個，且這4個全部包含在原始與變更後的允許聯集中。 聯集6+5−2=9個，額外權限9−4=5個。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compliance is workloads passing the selected policy divided by applicable workloads; extra read-only rules must not be mislabeled as universal standard requirements. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Nine of twelve workloads pass the pinned Restricted version and local additions; three have identified gaps. Initial pass rate=9/12=75%.

Effective permissions are the union of applicable allows; removing one binding does not guarantee revocation. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Role A permits six distinct actions and B five, with two overlapping; the controller needs four actions, all contained in both the original and changed permission unions. The union contains 6+5−2=9 actions, five beyond the four required.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Checkov：Terraform計畫與變更風險差異
related.titleEn: Checkov: Terraform plans and change-risk diffs
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付12項政策表、三個修正方案、準入正負樣本與例外到期測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver twelve policy rows, three remediation plans, admission fixtures and exception-expiry tests.
related.difference: 把原始設定、解析後計畫與政策結果連結，針對新增、更新、刪除分別審查。
related.differenceEn: Link source configuration, resolved plan and policy results, reviewing creates, updates and deletes separately.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合規比例=通過所選政策的工作負載/適用工作負載；額外唯讀要求不能誤稱為全部標準的必需條件。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 12個工作負載中9個通過指定Restricted版本與本地附加政策，3個有明確缺口。 初始通過率9/12=75%。
新增缺口=計畫後違規集合減既有違規集合；總違規數不變也可能掩蓋新風險。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 基線有8個違規，計畫修復3個但新增4個；所有識別均為本機合成資源。 計畫後8−3+4=9個，淨增1，但新增缺口是4個。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compliance is workloads passing the selected policy divided by applicable workloads; extra read-only rules must not be mislabeled as universal standard requirements. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Nine of twelve workloads pass the pinned Restricted version and local additions; three have identified gaps. Initial pass rate=9/12=75%.

New gaps are post-plan violations absent from the baseline; unchanged total counts can conceal newly introduced risk. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. The baseline has eight violations; a plan fixes three but introduces four on synthetic local resource identities. Post-plan total=8−3+4=9, a net increase of one but four newly introduced gaps.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
